sources.snippet: Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-NVFP4 is a frontier-scale large language model (LLM) trained by NVIDIA, designed to deliver strong agentic, reasoning, and conversational capabilities. It is optimized for the most demanding workloads, including complex multi-step agents, long-context analysis, and high-accuracy reasoning over code, math, and science.
